common_harness.base_framework: OpenHands SDK through ProWorkSim HarnessPort and WorldCore
common_harness.members_per_team: fixed per organization, from two to four
common_harness.comparison_scope: fixed sizes, decision rights and evidence-bound organization protocols
common_harness.budget_scope: one shared cumulative input plus output pool, not per-member copies
common_harness.public_task_board: unchanged shared managed task metadata; not a private edge channel
common_harness.patch_use: fixed versions remain public under the existing harness; direct handoffs follow declared routes and incorporation always requires explicit managed merge
common_harness.public_tests: same confined repository public entrypoint and same-version evidence
common_harness.code_endpoint: unique final workspace of member_001 at the frozen closure boundary
common_harness.delivery_endpoint: last legal submission by member_001, separately evidenced and scored
common_harness.schedule: fair round-robin filtered by persisted organization eligibility
common_harness.phase_progress: explicit accepted evidence, never a repeating clock alone

organizations.name: 集中负责人

member_001.title: 负责人兼集成者
member_001.instruction: Authorize task assignments and integration choices. Preserve current ownership until its owner and recipient execute the ordinary accepted transfer.

member_002.title: 仓库定位员
member_002.instruction: Locate code and report concrete evidence to the lead. Accept only assignments authorized by the lead; do not acquire managerial rights.

member_003.title: 实现者
member_003.instruction: Implement assigned work in your own workspace, test and publish a fixed patch for the lead to select and explicitly integrate.

member_004.title: 质量复核者
member_004.instruction: Inspect published candidates and send evidence-based advice to the lead; you do not replace its organization decision authority.

phases.name: 组织状态约束下的公平轮转

organizations.organization_instruction: Only member_001 authorizes assignments and candidate choices. Ordinary messages do not grant these rights or transfer task ownership.
organizations.schedule_semantics: round-robin over eligible runnable members; no automatic handoff, test, merge, decision, submission or next sprint
notes: Project adaptation, not a complete source-method reproduction.

organizations.name: 产物交接流水线

member_001.title: 需求设计与最终集成
member_001.instruction: Create and hand off a task-bound design. Later integrate the verified fixed candidate; do not skip the evidence-gated stages.

member_002.title: 实现
member_002.instruction: Implement the accepted design, own the relevant task through its normal claim or accepted transfer, and hand off an immutable candidate.

member_003.title: 验证
member_003.instruction: Explicitly adopt the candidate, execute public tests on that exact tree, and hand back evidence or return the work for a named reason.

phases.name: 组织状态约束下的公平轮转

organizations.organization_instruction: Design, implementation and verification handoffs must bind exact task revisions, patch identities and executed test evidence. Exhausting turns is not stage completion.
organizations.schedule_semantics: round-robin over eligible runnable members; no automatic handoff, test, merge, decision, submission or next sprint
notes: Project adaptation, not a complete source-method reproduction.

organizations.name: 开发复核返修

member_001.title: 开发兼交付
member_001.instruction: Develop and publish your candidate. Obtain an independent review of that precise version and satisfy the normal delivery evidence.

member_002.title: 独立复核
member_002.instruction: Review member_001's published candidate and record acceptance or requested changes bound to its exact version. You may inspect and test privately.

phases.name: 组织状态约束下的公平轮转

organizations.organization_instruction: Only member_002 may accept or request changes to the author candidate. Editing after acceptance invalidates use of that review for the new working version.
organizations.schedule_semantics: round-robin over eligible runnable members; no automatic handoff, test, merge, decision, submission or next sprint
inspiration: Bacchelli and Bird modern code review
notes: Project adaptation, not a complete source-method reproduction.

organizations.name: 短周期自管理

member_001.title: 开发兼交付
member_001.instruction: As a developer, co-select the sprint work and plan implementation with member_002. Explicitly integrate and deliver without waiting for a ceremony.

member_002.title: 开发
member_002.instruction: Co-select sprint work and self-organize implementation. PO orders goals and SM facilitates; neither assigns your individual coding decisions.

member_003.title: Product Owner
member_003.instruction: Order work within the unchanged original issue, propose the sprint goal, and negotiate scope changes with both developers.

member_004.title: Scrum Master
member_004.instruction: Facilitate planning and actual-evidence review. Do not allocate implementation tasks for the developers or automatically declare success.

phases.name: 组织状态约束下的公平轮转

organizations.organization_instruction: The two developers accept a public goal and select a plan; PO orders the backlog, SM facilitates review. The fixed opportunity clock can request review but never opens another sprint or changes the original issue automatically.
organizations.sprint_quota_status: CPU implementation control; formal evaluation not frozen
organizations.schedule_semantics: round-robin over eligible runnable members; no automatic handoff, test, merge, decision, submission or next sprint
notes: Project adaptation, not a complete source-method reproduction.

organizations.name: 项目与技术双权责

member_001.title: 项目协调兼集成
member_001.instruction: Confirm task scope and priorities and integrate only candidates with matching project and technical confirmations. Do not override technical refusal.

member_002.title: 技术负责人
member_002.instruction: Confirm technical requirements and review exact fixed candidates. Resolve disagreement explicitly with the project coordinator.

member_003.title: 实现者甲
member_003.instruction: Own accepted implementation work and publish its task-bound candidate for independent project-scope and technical confirmation.

member_004.title: 实现者乙
member_004.instruction: Own accepted implementation work and publish its task-bound candidate for independent project-scope and technical confirmation.

phases.name: 组织状态约束下的公平轮转

organizations.organization_instruction: Tasks keep one actual owner. Scope and technical confirmations are distinct records; neither authority may forge, replace or bypass the other confirmation.
organizations.schedule_semantics: round-robin over eligible runnable members; no automatic handoff, test, merge, decision, submission or next sprint
inspiration: Galbraith matrix organization; one-issue dual-authority adaptation
notes: Project adaptation, not a complete source-method reproduction.
